# os-plugin — OpenStrata Plugin Template

identity: OpenStrata.NET.Plugin

Short name: os-plugin

Primary output: `Plugin\\OstrataTemplate.1.Plugin.csproj`

Description: Scaffolds a plugin project targeting Dataverse / Dynamics with references to OpenStrata MSBuild plugin helpers.

Parameters

- `ostrata-version`: (optional) default `1.*`

Usage example

```powershell
dotnet new os-plugin
```
